n = int(input())
d = int(input())

v = []
n -= 1
m = n
while n:
    v.append(n % d)
    n //= d

MOD = 10**9 + 7
lg = 64
lg2 = 34

class Node:
    def __init__(self):
        self.dp = [[0]*(lg2+1) for _ in range(lg2+1)]
        self.cnt = [[0]*(lg2+1) for _ in range(lg2+1)]
        self.mark = [False]*(lg2+1)
        self.tark = [False]*(lg2+1)

    def merge(self, other):
        for i in range(d+1):
            for j in range(d+1):
                self.cnt[i][j] = 0
                for k in range(d+1):
                    self.cnt[i][j] = (self.cnt[i][j] + self.dp[k][j] * other.dp[i][k]) % MOD
        for i in range(d):
            if self.mark[i] and not other.mark[i]:
                for j in range(d+1):
                    self.cnt[i][j] = self.dp[i][j]
            if not self.mark[i] and other.mark[i]:
                for j in range(d+1):
                    self.cnt[j][i] = other.dp[j][i]
            self.mark[i] |= other.mark[i]
        for i in range(d+1):
            for j in range(d+1):
                self.dp[i][j] = self.cnt[i][j]

    def clear(self):
        for i in range(d+1):
            for j in range(d+1):
                self.dp[i][j] = self.cnt[i][j] = 0

    def shift(self, x):
        for i in range(d+1):
            for j in range(d+1):
                self.cnt[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(d):
            for j in range(d):
                self.cnt[(i + x) % d][(j + x) % d] = self.dp[i][j]
            self.cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = self.dp[i][d]
        for i in range(d):
            self.cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = self.dp[d][i]
        self.cnt[d][d] = self.dp[d][d]
        for i in range(d+1):
            for j in range(d+1):
                self.dp[i][j] = self.cnt[i][j]
        for i in range(d):
            self.tark[i] = self.mark[(i + x) % d]
        for i in range(d):
            self.mark[i] = self.tark[i]

def get_node(x):
    h = x
    pw = 1
    t = -1
    while h >= d:
        h //= d
        pw *= d
        t += 1
    x %= pw
    if t == -1:
        return hp[h]
    ans = md[t]
    ht = md[t]
    for _ in range(1, h):
        ht.shift(1)
        ans.merge(ht)
    ht = get_node(x)
    ht.shift(h)
    ans.merge(ht)
    return ans

# Initialize arrays
MAX_LG = lg + 5
hp = [Node() for _ in range(MAX_LG)]
md = [Node() for _ in range(len(v)+1)]
ht = Node()

# Setup hp[0]
hp[0].dp[d][d] = 2
hp[0].dp[d][0] = -1
hp[0].dp[0][d] = 1
hp[0].mark[0] = True
md[0] = hp[0]

# Build md[0] with other hp[i]
for i in range(1, d):
    hp[i].dp[d][d] = 2
    hp[i].dp[d][i] = -1
    hp[i].dp[i][d] = 1
    hp[i].mark[i] = True
    md[0].merge(hp[i])
    hp[i] = md[0]

# Build md for each position in v
for i in range(1, len(v)+1):
    md[i] = md[i-1]
    ht = md[i-1]
    for _ in range(1, d):
        ht.shift(1)
        md[i].merge(ht)

# Get the answer node
ans = get_node(m)
print(ans.dp[d][d])
